summary: Full backend + frontend testing for PetaPembeli. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passed covering auth (owner login, /me, unauthorized), phone normalization via save (+62 format), /api/extract with real TikTok screenshot (returns expected fields kitkatmatcha01_/Rizka F/+6282388792664/catlovers29/Padang/West Sumatra with per-field confidence), customer save + dedupe (order_count increments, is_repeat=true, first_seen preserved), skip rows without phone, customers list + filters + repeat_only, /api/customers/filters, /api/stats, and operator CRUD (owner creates operator, operator logs in, operator gets 403 on /api/operators, toggle deactivates so login yields 403). Frontend: end-to-end Playwright flow — owner login -> Upload & Ekstraksi -> file input -> extraction call -> quick-correct table renders with phone normalized to +6282388792664, tiktok=kitkatmatcha01_, kota=Padang -> Simpan ke Database triggers success toast -> Database Pelanggan page shows saved customer with 'Pembeli Berulang' badge (order_count=2 due to two save operations across tests), search by 'kitkatmatcha' returns 1 row, filter-repeat-toggle works. No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: Owner role can technically toggle itself if role check missed; current code guards owner from being toggled (good). No issue but worth noting.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py is a single 574-line file — consider splitting routes/auth/extraction into modules for maintainability but not critical.

MongoDB unique index on customers.phone means the very first save of a row without a normalized phone would still be fine (skipped), but any legacy empty-string phone doc could block future inserts; current code guards this by skipping empty phones.
seed_admin only resets password if owner exists with different hash; does not reactivate owner if manually deactivated (not blocking).
extract endpoint has no per-request rate limiting or size cap on individual image base64 length (only max 30 images); acceptable for MVP.
